title: Patients
intro: Look up a patient by phone number, or register a new one. Allergies are shown first.

lookup.heading: Find a patient
lookup.label: Phone number
lookup.hint: 10 digits. The match appears by itself once all digits are typed.
lookup.notFound: No patient found with this number
lookup.notFoundBody: You can register this patient now. Only the phone number is required.

allergies.heading: Allergies
allergies.addHint: Free text, for example the name of a drug or food. Press Enter or the Add button.
allergies.unsaved: You have unsaved changes to the allergy list.
allergies.tooLong: An allergy can be at most {{max}} characters.
allergies.tooMany: A patient can have at most {{max}} allergies.
allergies.duplicate: This allergy is already in the list.

register.title: Register a new patient
register.description: Only the phone number is required. Everything else can be added later.
register.name: Name (optional)
register.dobFuture: The date of birth cannot be in the future.
register.optInHint: Whether the clinic may send this patient messages.

session.heading: Open a consent page
session.intro: If a doctor started a session for a patient, open its consent page here using the session code or link they gave you.
session.label: Session code
session.hint: The long code at the end of the consent link, for example 5eed0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000100.
session.invalid: That is not a valid session code.

abha.title: ABHA check
abha.intro: Check an ABHA with a one-time password (OTP). This is a test feature: it only works with test identities, never with real people.

notice.mock: MOCK: a simulated check with fake identities. Nothing is sent to ABDM and this is not a real ABHA verification.
notice.sandbox: SANDBOX: the ABDM test environment, with test identities only. This is not a real person and not a real verification.

abha.alreadyBody: ABHA address {{address}}, checked {{when}}. You can check again.

enter.title: Enter a test ABHA
enter.attest: The patient has agreed to this ABHA check.
enter.label: Test ABHA number or address

hint.mock: Use one of the fake test identities below. Real ABHA numbers and Aadhaar numbers are refused.
hint.sandbox: Use a test identity from the ABDM sandbox. Real ABHA numbers and Aadhaar numbers are refused.

hint.mock: In the mock, the fake OTP is shown in the list on the previous step.
hint.sandbox: The OTP is sent by ABDM to the test account.

result.title: ABHA checked ({{mode}})
result.stored: Only the ABHA address, the time and a scrambled fingerprint of the number are kept. The number and the OTP are not stored.

rejected.title: This test ABHA is not allowed
rejected.body: Only the listed test identities can be used. Real ABHA numbers and Aadhaar numbers are never accepted.

wrong.title: The OTP is not correct
wrong.body: Check the OTP and try again. Tries left: {{count}}.

expired.title: The OTP has expired
expired.body: Start again to get a new OTP.

limited.title: Too many tries
limited.body: Wait a few minutes, then start again.

down.title: The ABHA service is not answering
down.body: Try again in a few minutes. Nothing was saved.

unknown.title: No ABHA account found
unknown.body: Check the test identity and try again.

failed.title: The ABHA check did not work
failed.body: Nothing was saved. Try again, or ask the owner to check the sandbox settings.
